messages:
sam: hey team, sam here (security eng). first day and my Google account isn't active yet. Tried to enroll Okta Verify but i get 'No devices available to set up' after login. anyone know who to ping?
it-bot: Ticket IT-2275 created for @sam. If urgent, run `/pager nina`.

nina: welcome @sam! that message usually means your identity record didn't fully provision. can you confirm the email you used to sign up? also check if you got a 1Password invite to your personal email.

sam: used sam@redwood.com. no 1Password invite in spam either.

nina: thanks. i'm reissuing the 1Password invite and will reset your MFA factors. give me ~10m.

kevin: hey @sam, FYI if the Okta flow is flaky you can do Manual Setup and paste the secret into 1Password OTP field once the invite comes through. saves time.

it-bot: IT-2275 updated by nina. Action: resend 1Password invite; reset MFA. ETA 15m.

sam: got the 1Password invite now, accepted and added OTP. manual setup worked and email is active. thanks both!

nina: great — welcome aboard! i'll follow up to add you to the security GH teams. ping here if anything else blocks you.
